'''Thoma''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he went on a mission to investigate alien mercenaries that have trained themselves to join the Empire. While investigating inside the Mercenary Training Facility Barracks, his mission ended in failure when he was killed by the Imperial mercenaries.<ref name="TOR" />
